raw_blocks: Healthcare Revenue Cycle & EHR Solutions That Drive Results
From towns of 200 to cities of 200,000, TruBridge has the solutions your healthcare organization needs to stay independent and financially stable.
Creating Stronger Communities Through Better Healthcare

TruBridge helps rural hospitals, critical access hospitals, community hospitals, and clinics stay financially strong and achieve better financial, operational, and clinical outcomes. We offer technology and revenue cycle management services backed by more than 45 years of healthcare experience and trusted by over 1,500 clients across the U.S.
Technology & Services Built for Healthcare Performance

We deliver revenue cycle services, medical coding support, and EHR technology tailored to community-based healthcare organizations, ensuring operational strength so high-quality care can stay close to home. We combine proven healthcare technology with specialized support teams so you can improve productivity, strengthen revenue, and deliver better patient care.
Electronic Health Record & Information Systems
EHR solutions that simplify workflows, improve data access, and support smarter care decisions for your teams.
Medical Coding Technology & Services
Ensure accurate coding, compliance, and optimized reimbursement with expert coding services and technology.
Revenue Cycle Services & Outsourcing
Maximize revenue, reduce denials, and strengthen financial performance while keeping care close to your community.
Revenue Cycle Management Solutions & Services
End-to-end revenue cycle management solutions and services for hospitals, critical access facilities, and ambulatory clinics.
Whether your town has one stoplight, or you’re part of a larger community, TruBridge solutions are designed with your organization in mind. We serve hospitals, ambulatory clinics, and physicians.
Supporting your financial and clinical health
Helping providers save time, money and clear the way for care
Empowering ambulatory care to keep moving forward
Achieving impactful goals with industry-leading solutions

We don’t deal in one-size-fits-all solutions. We treat each client as a unique case, joining data-driven insights with our wealth of experience to create a solution that delivers the results they need. Through a suite of innovative products and collaborative services, we help our clients eliminate the financial and operational obstacles holding them back and lay the foundation for lasting success. We are a healthcare solutions company and we clear the way for care®.
One facility increased cash on hand from $3.8M to $4.8M per month

nTrust is a flexible, minimal risk program that lets you access our leading revenue cycle solutions and future product innovations with no upfront costs, maintenance charges or future licensing fees. We simply extract a percentage of your collections to cover costs, meaning we don’t get paid until you do.
Reduce AR days by 30% with RCM
Focus on what matters: care for your patients
Our Revenue Cycle Management solutions offer an arsenal of flexible, transparent, HFMA® Peer Reviewed RCM products and services focused on exceeding expectations.
Recover up to 70% of denied claims
Achieve collection goals while effectively managing your team’s workload
Let our AR Clean Up collections experts work your aging small balance co-pays, low-dollar insurance claims and other time-consuming tasks to deliver results that truly add up.
$1.5 million in recovered reimbursement

Bayou Bend needed a more effective way to ensure reimbursements matched contracted rates without adding staff or administrative burden. By consistently comparing actual payments against contracted rates across all claims, the team could identify discrepancies more efficiently.
Clearing the way for care through real client success

Every healthcare organization has a story of overcoming challenges to better serve its community. We partner with hospitals and health systems to remove barriers, streamline operations, and strengthen financial and clinical performance so providers can focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care. Learn more how our clients are creating lasting impact with the support of TruBridge.
Recognized Leader in Rural Hospital Revenue Cycle Solutions

TruBridge partners with the Rural Health Collaborative (RHC) and the Healthcare Management Academy (THMA) to help rural hospitals modernize revenue cycle operations, strengthen financial resilience, and improve care quality. Our award-winning RCM solutions, recognized by Black Book and Modern Healthcare, reduce denials, accelerate cash flow, and address staffing and administrative challenges. TruBridge empowers rural healthcare leaders to optimize revenue and maintain sustainable financial health across underserved communities.
Recognized as “Best in Business” by Modern Healthcare
TruBridge was named one of Modern Healthcare’s “Best in Business” for measurable RCM outcomes. We help rural hospitals accelerate speed-to-cash, reduce denials, and improve financial predictability.

TruBridge partners with THMA to lead the Rural Health Collaborative (RHC), connecting rural hospital leaders, policymakers, and peers. Members gain funding insights, technology guidance, and peer-driven best practices to strengthen financial resilience, modernize operations, and improve quality of care.
2026 Black Book Benchmark Leader

Black Book surveyed 162 rural hospital RCM leaders, recognizing TruBridge as the 2026 benchmark leader for End-to-End, Front-End, and Complete/Extended RCM. Our solutions reduce denials, improve cash flow, and optimize revenue cycle performance.

We offers a full suite of HFMA-certified revenue cycle solutions designed to help hospitals navigate economic pressures and improve financial health. Our offerings include RCM to optimize cash flow and streamline operations, CBO services to handle billing, collections, and administrative workflows efficiently, and Medical Coding Services that ensure accuracy, compliance, and faster reimbursement.
